title: Pilot vouches for Marzulli's source using details he held back

tellings.quote: he purposely withheld certain details from the story so that if somebody comes forward trying to add additional information, he could vet whether or not they're telling the truth and he said that guy is telling the truth.

plain: A pilot who once told his own story deliberately left some details out, so that he could test anyone who later came forward claiming to know more, and around 2005 he used those hidden details to vouch for a source of L.A. Marzulli, an author on ancient giants and the supernatural. The filmmaker Tim Alberino tells Michels this, naming Marzulli and the radio host Steve Quayle. In his words, the pilot "said that guy is telling the truth," which, if so, would back up the source's account.
